name: Disrupting Logistics

angles.text: Priests recognize the vital role healing support plays in sustaining an offensive line, making the Al'Aketh healers the linchpin of the cultist assault.
Slipping behind enemy lines to eliminate high-priority healers and disrupt vanguard reinforcements is standard tactical sabotage for rogues.

faq.answer: Disrupting Logistics is an urgent defensive mission to blunt a full-scale assault by Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands. A lone defender holding the line requires immediate aid to take out the enemy's front-line sustainment before their defenders collapse entirely.
faq.q: What is the quest Disrupting Logistics?

faq.answer: The attackers are Al'Aketh cultists, comprising aggressive brawlers and supportive healers pressing an active assault into the Gustberry Lowlands. Their organized front relies heavily on dedicated healing support to maintain continuous pressure against the local defenders.
faq.q: Who are the Al'Aketh cultists attacking the lowlands?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh healers provide the continuous restorative support that keeps the vanguard fighters charging forward without respite. By cutting off these healers, the defense hopes to break the momentum of the assault and create an opening to rally and push the cultists back.
faq.q: Why are the Al'Aketh healers specifically targeted?

faq.answer: The Gustberry Lowlands sit directly down the hill from the defensive outpost being besieged by the cultists. It is currently overrun by Al'Aketh brawlers and healers pushing their forward assault.
faq.q: Where does this assault take place?

faq.answer: Valennia appears to be a leader or coordinator responsible for organizing aid and reinforcements, though the defender expresses exasperation that Valennia managed to send only a single adventurer to counter a massive assault.

aliases: who are my people holding out
faq.answer: The quest is offered by a beleaguered defender whose people are on the brink of being overwhelmed by the Al'Aketh cultists. Expressing reverence for 'the winds,' the defender is desperate for any fighting force to turn the tide of battle.
faq.q: Who commands the defense against the Al'Aketh?

sections.body: A fierce assault threatens to overwhelm the defenders stationed above the Gustberry Lowlands. With enemy forces massing and local lines stretched to the breaking point, desperation has set in for the frontline commanders. Expecting substantial reinforcements from Valennia, the defenders find themselves forced to rely on whatever capable hands arrive, praying that surgical strikes against the enemy's support network can stave off imminent collapse.
sections.title: A Desperate Defense

sections.body: The Al'Aketh assault relies on coordinated ranks of fierce brawlers anchored by dedicated healers who mend wounds and sustain the frontline push. Down in the Gustberry Lowlands, eliminating these healers breaks the backbone of the cultist offensive, cutting off their logistical endurance and allowing the defenders an opportunity to rally and repel the invasion.
sections.title: Breaking the Cultist Line

summary: Disrupting Logistics tasks adventurers with blunting a full-scale Al'Aketh cultist assault in the Gustberry Lowlands. By eliminating the enemy healers who sustain the frontline brawlers, players help beleaguered local defenders turn the tide before their lines collapse.
